name: pencil2d-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Pencil2D traditional 2D animation creation and rendering
author: chriz-3656

tools.name: pencil2d_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Pencil2D project (.pclx file), returning canvas resolution, FPS, keyframe counts, layers, and palette.

tools.name: pencil2d_create
tools.description: Create a new blank Pencil2D project (.pclx) with specified canvas resolution, FPS, and layers.

tools.name: pencil2d_add_frame
tools.description: Add or replace a keyframe image in a Pencil2D project bitmap layer.

tools.name: pencil2d_extract_frames
tools.description: Extract all frame PNG images from a .pclx file into a target directory.

tools.name: pencil2d_export
tools.description: Render a Pencil2D animation project to video (MP4), animated GIF, or image sequence using the Pencil2D AppImage CLI.

tools.name: pencil2d_launch_gui
tools.description: Open a project (or a new workspace) inside the Pencil2D GUI for visual animation editing.
